one_line: Makhdoom scholar of Ponnani, author of Tuhfat al-Mujahidin on the wars with the Portuguese.

appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown Malabar complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, calm sharp eyes with slightly heavy lids, default expression thoughtful and resolute
appearance.hair: short, tidy black hair mostly hidden beneath a plain white cotton turban wrapped low and snug around the head, with one narrow tail falling over the left shoulder
appearance.costume: long-sleeved knee-length white cotton tunic (kurta-style) with a simple round neck, worn over a slightly off-white cotton dhoti wrapped and pleated to fall to the ankles, a light cream shawl with a subtle thin brown border draped from the left shoulder across the torso, and simple brown leather sandals; no ornate jewelry, just a modest silver ring on the right hand
appearance.signature: a narrow, well-used palm-leaf manuscript bundle tied with a dark brown cord and held in his left hand, with one loose leaf partly unfurled in his right hand as if he is about to read or lecture

ref_desc: Zainuddin Makhdoom II is a thoughtful, medium-brown Malabar scholar in a white turban, white tunic, off-white dhoti, cream shawl, simple sandals and silver ring, carrying a narrow palm-leaf manuscript bundle in warm white, cream, brown and black tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Zainuddin Makhdoom II: a lean early-forties Malabar scholar with an oval medium-brown face, sharp calm eyes, straight nose and neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, wearing a plain white cotton turban wrapped snugly with a small tail over his left shoulder. He is dressed in a knee-length long-sleeved white tunic with a simple round neck over an off-white cotton dhoti pleated and wrapped down to his ankles, a light cream shawl with a subtle thin brown border draped from his left shoulder across the torso, and simple brown leather sandals, with no ornate jewelry, only a modest silver ring on his right hand. His signature prop is a narrow bundle of palm-leaf manuscripts tied with a dark brown cord in his left hand, while his right hand lightly holds one partly unfurled leaf as if reading. Use a restrained palette of white, cream, brown, black and a muted golden-beige accent, and present him front-facing in a clear, neutral pose that shows his face, turban, layered garments and manuscript bundle distinctly.
